Title: Rerum Aethiopicarum Scriptores Occidentales Inediti a saeculo XVI ad XIX, Vol. III: P. Petri Paez S.I. Historia Aethiopiae, Liber III et IV
Creator: Pedro Paez, S.J.; edited by Camillo Beccari, S.I.
Publisher: Rome: excudebat C. de Luigi
Publication Date: 1906
Rights: Public Domain (published 1906, more than 95 years ago; the host marks the item NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT)
Language: por (Paez's Portuguese text, with Beccari's Latin introduction, marginal summaries and notes in Latin)
Source: Internet Archive item rerumaethiopica01beccgoog, file rerumaethiopica01beccgoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-23; host rights statement: possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT; digitized by Google; contributor University of Michigan
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged, including the Google Books notice at the front (no long s present). Rights basis: a 1906 Rome publication, public domain by date.
Content note: Books III and IV of Paez's History of Ethiopia (the Jesuit mission under the emperors Za Dengel, Yaqob and Susenyos, as Beccari's introduction describes it). The volume number is read off the title page. Paez's Portuguese is printed in the left column with Latin summaries beside it. OCR sampled at five points and found readable Portuguese, with scattered errors; some Latin margin text is run into the Portuguese column. Books I and II are in another volume of the series, not vendored.
